'''2009 Worlds Team Tournament SAN LS Watch Your Step''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[SAN]] at [[2009 World Championship]] (Team Tournament).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Watch Your Step / This Place Can Be A Little Rough]]
* '''Username:''' GHOSTTRAIN
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Team Tournament
